title: Edge Telemetry Module Profile v1
summary: An edge device, SBC, firmware, or IoT module that captures telemetry, controls devices, syncs data, and exposes health.

integration_points.name: telemetry_streams
integration_points.description: Stream format, timestamps, stats, and capture capabilities.

integration_points.name: field_operations
integration_points.description: Device deployment, configuration, health, connectivity, and rollback.

checks: Stream descriptors declare timestamp fields, record format, files, and stats.
Device target and deployment context are explicit.
Telemetry permissions and control commands are declared.
Offline, retry, and connectivity behavior are documented.
Health and diagnostics are discoverable for field support.

agent_guidance: Use this profile for device, firmware, telemetry, and edge-service integration work.
Preserve stream timestamp semantics and deployment context.
Report telemetry streams, device targets, permissions, and field health checks.
